interest: Shows interwar disputes over American property, probate, and leases in Japan, plus a Hawaii labor protest against a Japanese store.
overview: Docket for file 894.5211 (1929-39) indexes inquiries on American property rights in Japan: probate and inheritance cases, perpetual-lease wind-downs, landholder lists, treaty leasing rights, and a Hawaii labor protest against a Mitsukoshi store.

subfiles.about: Department of State List of Papers indexing correspondence, memoranda, and cross-reference sheets concerning the rights of American nationals to hold, acquire, inherit, and lease real property in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Lists 1929-39 records on American property rights in Japan, including probate inquiries, perpetual-lease wind-downs with Britain, landholder lists, treaty leasing interpretations, and a Honolulu labor protest against a Japanese department store.
